suggestion: Make the header coverage label per page instead of global.
why: Pages now publish artefacts with different end dates, so one global window label makes a page covering 2026-11-21 look like it stops at 2026-11-18.
options: (a) per-page label from each page's own coverage; (b) keep global and add a per-page subtitle; (c) do nothing.
recommended_option: (a) per-page label - small, contained to the layout helper.

suggestion: Publish a signed index of every results chain head, with its entry count.
why: The canonical and round feeds are deliberately separate so earlier settlement evidence stays valid. An index of chain heads would let a reader confirm at a glance that both verify, instead of taking a paragraph of explanation on trust.
options: (a) a small index page listing each chain, head hash and count; (b) fold both into one chain; (c) do nothing.
recommended_option: (a) - additive and touches no existing chain.

suggestion: Store a layout signature per injury revision and alert when it changes.
why: The 12:30 AM revision merged three teams into one cell while reporting identical statuses. A signature of cell counts per row would flag that automatically and separate 'the roster changed' from 'the PDF was re-rendered' for every future revision.
options: (a) store the signature and diff it; (b) keep manual review of structure notes; (c) do nothing.
recommended_option: (a) - additive metadata, no change to the parsed rows.

suggestion: Publish a revision-count-versus-change-count chart across the season.
why: This round produced four revisions with zero status changes. Over a season that ratio measures how much information a new revision actually carries, which is what determines how often the pipeline needs to poll.
options: (a) add the chart to the injuries page; (b) report it only at round level; (c) do nothing.
recommended_option: (a) - derived entirely from archives already stored.

suggestion: Run a settlement pass over open ledger entries now that the 2026-11-16..18 finals are verified.
why: The 25 new finals are verified and every quarter sum ties. Entries dated inside that window could be settled against them with a visible stamp, closing a gap rather than opening one. This session did not run that pass, so it is proposed rather than done.
options: (a) dry run, diff the stamps, then apply; (b) apply directly; (c) wait for the refresh.
recommended_option: (a) - a settlement stamp is a write onto existing records and should be diffed first.

suggestion: Backfill the three club-games whose per-player rows publish minutes only.
why: Five of eight 2026-11-15 club-games fully reconcile; the other three contribute 35 minutes-only rows. Backfilling would let minutes redistribution run on complete box scores and would show whether the gap was the source or the parser.
options: (a) parse the official game books on the runner; (b) leave as minutes-only and label; (c) drop the day.
dependency: Needs a runner that can fetch the game book PDFs.
